description:
Lucy Alan are pleased to present this two bedroom top floor apartment in the Mounts. Offered to the market with no onward chain, this well presented property would make an ideal first time buy or investment.

The accommodation is accessed via the communal area and then comprises a lounge/dining area which leads open plan to the modern fitted kitchen. There are two bedrooms and a shower room. 

Externally there is an allocated car parking space in a resident's car park.

LEASE INFORMATION

Service charge and ground rent- Approx £1650 per year

Car park- Approx £40 per year

Lease- Approx 114 years
